fusions.name: Bitter Reckoning
fusions.desc: A long thrust that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn.

fusions.name: Return to Sender
fusions.desc: A burst that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You restore 6 health.

fusions.name: General Amnesty
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and from everyone in your party.

fusions.name: Sentence Served
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs its course, you restore 8 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
